criteria.tenure_99yr_rule: 99-year admitted only if (a) TOP within 10 years AND < 100 units, OR (b) up to 500 units AND some of the project's 3BR units exceed 1,110 sqft
criteria.built_1996_2000_small_freehold: flag as NEEDS-CHECK, do not auto-exclude
criteria.psf_over_cap: flag as OVER-CAP, do not auto-exclude
districts_primary: D19 (Kovan, Serangoon, Hougang, Bartley, Woodleigh, MacPherson subzones)
districts_secondary: D14 Eunos / Paya Lebar only (Geylang excluded)

buyer_age_check_note: For 99-year units the (buyer_age + remaining_lease >= 95) CPF/LTV rule is satisfied for any adult buyer when remaining lease is >= ~73 years (requires age >= ~22). All 99-year candidates below clear this comfortably.

A 2,045 sqft @ $1.0M snippet is implausible (~$489 psf) - stale/typo, excluded.

changes_since_baseline_2026_06_06: Criteria changed between runs (baseline used >1,000 sqft / $2.0-2.2M / D15+D19 only; today: >1,110 sqft / <$2.3M / >=3BR explicit / expanded to D19-full + D15-backup + D14 Eunos-Paya Lebar / PSF $1,700 cap). A strict day-over-day diff is therefore only partial.
The Line @ Tanjong Rhu: baseline #1 pick ($2.167M / 1,055 sqft) -> now fails the new size floor (1,055 < 1,110) AND smallest listed 3BR asks ~$3.0M. Dropped.
Bliss @ Kovan: baseline standout was a 1,765 sqft 2BR penthouse @ $2.2M -> a 2BR no longer qualifies (>=3BR now required); cheapest 3BR is $2.38M (over budget). Dropped from picks, kept as near-miss.
Flamingo Valley: still listed - a 1,152 sqft freehold 3BR @ $2.2M (OVER-CAP PSF). Consistent presence across both runs.

New this run (were out of baseline scope): The Waterline and Palm Grove Condominium (both D19 Hougang, clean PASS) and Siglap V (D15 backup, PASS) surface as the strongest matches under the expanded D19 mandate.
data_quality_caveats: All major portals (PropertyGuru, 99.co, SRX, EdgeProp, PropNex, SingaporeExpats, HomeJourney) were egress-blocked for direct automated fetch this run (confirmed connection refusal / 403, as in the 6 Jun run). Every figure is triangulated from search-result snippets and indexed project/listing pages.
Floor levels and agent names are generally NOT exposed in snippets and are marked 'unverified'. Exact live asking prices shift daily - treat unit prices as last-seen indicative.
Unit counts, TOP years and remaining-lease figures come from project index pages and are approximate (remaining lease +/- 1-2 years unless a lease-commencement date was confirmed).
Re-confirm current availability, exact floor, exact sqft and remaining lease with the agent before viewing or acting.
